description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleMenuConfigurator class which implements menu configuration for the HRM application's admin module. It modifies the screen based on the current module and screen context.

classes.name: JobTitleMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu for job titles within the admin module. Uses traits for module and screen helpers, and modifies the screen to override the 'viewJobTitleList' view.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the screen to 'viewJobTitleList' using helper methods, and returns null.
